title: Practice 2: «For a while»: по- and про-

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: I stood here for thirty minutes.
exercises.why: **простоял** — простоя́ть (perfective): to stand, to stay (for some time); to stand idle; to stand, to remain (of buildings). Wiktionary: про- + стоя́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **поищем** — поиска́ть (perfective): to look for, to search (for some time). Wiktionary: по- + иска́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **поищу** — поиска́ть (perfective): to look for, to search (for some time). Wiktionary: по- + иска́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to stand, to stay (for some time)
to look for, to search (for some time)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: пропе́ть — to sing; простоя́ть — to stand, to stay (for some time); поиска́ть — to look for, to search (for some time); поноси́ть — (transitive) to carry something (for a while).
